metadata.description: Architecture for Swift server backends: gRPC microservices behind a Hummingbird gateway, typed-throws use cases in a Core target, adapters per technology, and executable composition roots.

plugins.name: swift-microservices-architect
plugins.description: Architects Swift server backends as gRPC microservices behind a Hummingbird gateway, with one Swift package per service, a Core of typed-throws use cases, an adapter target per technology (Postgres with row-level security, gRPC, Temporal, Valkey) and an executable composition root. Use when planning a Swift backend or splitting it into services, drawing module boundaries or writing Package.swift, adding a service, endpoint, use case, repository, migration, multi-tenant table or durable Temporal workflow, wiring configuration, graceful shutdown, mTLS or JWT auth, naming server types and targets, setting up a package's CI/CD on GitHub Actions, or reviewing a Swift server's architecture or code style, even when the user doesn't name the architecture.
